prototypes.name: Quiz v2
prototypes.description: Onboarding quiz V2 for new customers: the answers build a personalised box of meals, with swaps and recommended add-ons.

versions.title: Responsive intro, new motion and meal modal
versions.changes: Added a 1024px breakpoint: intro goes image-left/copy-right, question and reinforcement steps sit in a 544px column. Rebuilt step animations (x-axis blur, cross-over exit, softer easing), press scale on options, and progress that counts reinforcement steps. Loader now hands over to results automatically. Satisfaction step has a Continue button and a neutral default face. New goal, household and eater icons, copy updates, and the meal modal rebuilt to match the website's MealDetailModal (no reviews).

versions.title: Controls in the studio
versions.changes: Added studio.json so the studio can drive the quiz from its controls: start point (homepage, quiz, loader, results), results page A or B, bundle, and challenge. No change to the quiz itself.

versions.title: First pass
versions.changes: Bouncing 'Hello World' lettering with a pulsing heart on a pink-to-blue gradient. Animations are disabled for reduced-motion users.

versions.title: Version 22 build
versions.changes: Pushed from the every-quiz-v22 working folder (fresh static export). Notes on what changed from v3.0 weren't written at the time.

versions.title: Rebuilt on team conventions (v23)
versions.changes: v21 refactored from plain HTML/JS into the team's Next.js conventions (Tailwind, ABC Diatype/Marist, one component per file, TODO(lift) markers). Replaces v3.1, which was a broken build. Includes the studio controls (start, variant, bundle, challenge).

versions.title: Latest build of quiz
versions.changes: Pushed the current static build of the quiz (homepage, quiz, loader, results A/B) as v3.3.

versions.title: Quiz flow map
versions.changes: Added a flow of every quiz step (homepage, ten quiz steps, loader, results A and B) so the studio can draw it. Added a ?step= link parameter (with start=quiz) so each step opens directly with sample answers filled in.

versions.title: Visual edits
versions.changes: Edited in the studio: 1 line of copy.

versions.title: Perfect Portions PDP: baseline and five variants
versions.changes: First version of the top of the Perfect Portions product page: header, hero, bundle box picker with price card, meals section and meal modal, built front end only with live Storyblok meals. Variant switcher in the studio covers five takes on the meals section: subhead sentence, tick chips, shelves by product type, circle recipe cards with tighter padding, and a featured one-at-a-time carousel with key ingredients. Variants 4 and 5 also override some meal photos and shorten the meal descriptions.

versions.title: Fix images on the studio
versions.changes: The logo, hero photo and replacement dish photos used absolute paths, so they 404ed under the studio's sub-path. They are now relative, and the meal modal resolves its photo before the URL changes. Nothing else changed.

versions.title: Swipe, dock and teaser for meal modal
versions.changes: Added v6 (v4 with swipe between meals in the meal modal, story-style progress and a first-open 'swipe to explore' hint), v7 (floating thumbnail dock to jump between meals) and v8 (floating 'Up next' teaser). Ticks chips on v2-v4 now use the bundle purple at 25% opacity. Removed the grabber bar from the meal modal.

versions.title: Fix v7 dock scrolling the page
versions.changes: The v7 thumbnail dock used scrollIntoView, which also scrolled the surrounding page when embedded. It now scrolls only its own strip.

versions.title: Fix page shift when menu modal opens
versions.changes: Opening 'See the full menu' removed the page scrollbar and shifted the content sideways. The shared scroll-lock hook now keeps the scrollbar's width as padding, as the meal detail modal already did.

versions.title: New v4, renumbered variants, v1 tiles
versions.changes: Added a new v4 (circle cards using the story's own recipe photos) and shifted the old v4-v8 to v5-v9. v1 now has v6's outlined nutrition tiles under the subhead and none below the menu button. Subheads on v1 and v6 use 16px body text and new copy (100% plant based, low sugar, no artificial additives, ~500 calories). More space (48px) above the meals headline on mobile in every variant.

versions.title: v4 as a 2x3 grid
versions.changes: v4 now shows only the first six meals in a static 2-column, 3-row grid instead of the carousel, with new card photos for the beetroot salad and ratatouille. Ratatouille is 7th in the box order, so its photo is not visible yet.

versions.title: New v4 card photos
versions.changes: v4 (2x3 grid of the first six meals) now uses new card photos for bami goreng, butter chicken, bolognese, chili sin carne, dal delight and the beetroot salad. Ratatouille's photo is uploaded but that meal is 7th in the box, so it does not show.

versions.title: Imported designer prototype
versions.changes: First upload of another designer's Discover redesign v2 HTML prototype, pushed as-is to see how the studio handles it.

versions.title: Curated meal modal tags (v10)
versions.changes: Added variant 10 (?v=10): the meal modal shows a curated tag set instead of every filter value. Vegan first, No Soy/Gluten/Garlic/Onion exclusions, merged fibre tag, one protein and one sugar tag, heat only when Medium or Very spicy. Other Without, fat and calorie tags are hidden in the modal only.

versions.title: Variant 10 in the picker
versions.changes: Added variant 10 (curated meal modal tags) to the studio's Variant control; v0.9 had the code but no way to select it.

versions.title: Assets linked into subfolders
versions.changes: Moved the redesign's image, icon, illustration and font references to point into the organised account-discover-assets subfolders so everything loads. Meals.png now uses featured-classic-reset-bowl-Meals.png.

versions.title: Variant 4 joined grid and menu modal
versions.changes: Variant 4: meal cards joined into one bordered grid (no gaps, #eee strokes, 18px clipped frame) with the last row cut in half and faded as a preview, the menu button then the nutrition tiles below. New Perfect Portions Menu modal with a 12/16/20 iOS-style switcher; tapping a recipe pushes it in as a page inside the modal with a back animation, scroll position kept, and recipe data fetched once and prefetched.

versions.title: Helena's copy updates
versions.changes: Applied Helena's copy edits from the Notion content guide: intro, question wording and answer options, loader lines, results hero headline, protein subhead and headline, and the Variant B challenge headings and cards. Left unclear or tbd items unchanged; results answer chips kept as they were.

versions.title: Gut health goal option
versions.changes: Added "Improve my gut health" as a fifth option on the goal question. It reuses the balanced-diet icon for now and routes to The Back to Better Bundle, since gut health has no bundle of its own yet.

versions.title: One flow: full menu and recipe modal
versions.changes: Down to a single flow (the story-photo grid with the Perfect Portions Menu modal); the other variants are gone. Menu modal: floating meal-count selector, sticky close button, scrolling heading with subhead, recipes push in with swipe between them and a fading back arrow. Recipe modal rebuilt to the Figma: review tag by the title, one-row nutrition bar, framed tags in the new ordered tag logic, open Ingredients with key ingredient tiles, animated accordions. Both modals animate out.

versions.title: Ingredient photos and key ingredients fix
versions.changes: Key ingredient tiles now use each ingredient's own photo, matched by name (500px WebP, 17.8MB down to 1.6MB). Fixed recipes that store key ingredients as bold name plus text, which showed none (e.g. crunchy beetroot salad).

versions.title: Dish photos in recipe modal, lighter images
versions.changes: Recipe modals use the new dishes photos (cards unchanged). Ingredient photos shrunk to 400px WebP and load at low priority; the modal hero loads first.

versions.title: Preload recipe hero photos
versions.changes: Opening the full menu now preloads every recipe's hero photo in menu order, so recipes open with their photo already loaded. Skips the unused CMS photo.

versions.title: Desktop layout, side previews, accordions
versions.changes: Desktop: meal grid is two rows of three with no fade, aligned to the hero. Recipe modal: side preview cards (photo, title, rating) to tap between meals, replacing swipe on desktop. Accordions open independently. Faster modal close (160ms). Removed the reviews.io write-a-review block.

versions.title: Menu toggle, new photos, nutrition table
versions.changes: Menu modal: pinned 20/22 meals toggle that makes room beside the close button, Eve illustration, 94% height. New card and modal photos. Meal modal: full ingredients above the 'without' tags; nutrition table split into kJ and kcal rows with units beside values, right-aligned and resized columns; tapping the macro bar opens and scrolls to nutrition. Pulsing placeholders while meals load, and modal photos preloaded when the grid scrolls into view.

versions.title: Faster image and menu loading
versions.changes: Card, modal and ingredient photos now load eagerly instead of waiting to scroll into view, including in the view-all modal. Products are cached in the browser so the skeleton only shows when there is no data. Pulsing placeholders while meals load for the first time.

versions.title: Live menu order, box pickers, compressed photos
versions.changes: Recipe order now matches the live site. Box pickers show 20 meals at 6,01 and 22 meals at 6,28 as Perfect Portions Plan Starter/Complete, and the menu modal toggle defaults to 22. Card and modal photos compressed (about 17MB down to under 3MB), Naked Taco card and modal photos added.

versions.title: Taller meal modal, square photo
versions.changes: Meal modal is now up to 94% of the viewport height and its photo is 1:1.

versions.title: Landing page hero, below-hero section and wider modals
versions.changes: Switched to the landing page hero (blurring nav, no sticky desktop card) with a new below-hero headline and image section. The meals and reviews now share the box background, the desktop menu is 4 across, and the recipe and menu modals are two-column on desktop with icon-only previous and next buttons. The 22 menu adds the müsli and cake bites, with an Only in 22 meal bundle tag on the 20 tab. Kcal and macros now come from the nutrition table, and the sticky add-to-cart bar shows on desktop and slides in with the bundle.

versions.title: Meal modal: image left on desktop
versions.changes: Swapped the desktop columns of the meal detail modal so the image sits on the left and the content on the right. Mobile layout unchanged.

versions.title: LP template with new box size picker and pricing
versions.changes: Started from the protein LP template. Restyled the meal-count pills (1.5px border that doesn't shift layout, per-week strip, POPULAR tag) and the price breakdown (Discounts dropdown with qty and first box lines, free shipping, total with the You save chip) to the new Figma design.

versions.title: Picker and pricing polish, desktop layout
versions.changes: Box size pills: Meals capitalised, tighter number/label, medium 12px per-meal price, week strip pinned to the bottom. Price breakdown: discount lines show Qty and First box percentages, You save chip sits by the total. Desktop: bundle section now uses the same max-width container as the other LP sections (48px headings, picker max 412, pricing max 766).

versions.title: First pass from lp-protein template
versions.changes: Scaffolded from the lp-protein template with no design edits. Exported as a static site, with the meal detail modal answering from sample meals instead of /api/product.

versions.title: Account home dashboard (Variant B)
versions.changes: First push to the studio: the Variant-B-only build (account-home-3) — a goal-persona switch in place of named personas, a home dashboard with meals/plants/streak/on-track stats and macro tracking against the goal's targets, a screen-wide profile header, and matching My Plan and All Meals tabs.

versions.title: Protein PDP from template, baby blue theme
versions.changes: Built out the protein PDP from the team's pdp-protein reference template (hero, bundle/meal picker, reviews, USP grid, ingredients with expert reviews, routine, FAQ, subscribe). Swapped the product's green theme colour for baby blue across the hero, reviews band, ingredients, after-a-few-weeks and subscribe sections. Moved the meal-detail fetch from a server API route to a client-side call direct to the Storyblok CDN, and restored the starter's export-mode next.config.ts, since studio prototypes must be static.

versions.title: Initial scaffold
versions.changes: First version, scaffolded from the Protein Bundle PDP template.

versions.title: States as studio controls
versions.changes: The prototype bar's states (customer, viewing as, delivery, moment and box) are now controls the studio shows beside the prototype. Inside the studio the in-page bar steps aside; opened on its own it is unchanged.

versions.title: Controls change live
versions.changes: The studio's controls now update the prototype in place, without reloading it, including switching a control back to its default.

versions.title: Bundle section and price breakdown
versions.changes: Latest work on the landing-page bundle section, price breakdown and bundle variant pills, plus updated protein bundle sample data. Pushed without a detailed write-up.

versions.title: Re-upload with working source link
versions.changes: No changes to the prototype. Re-uploaded so the GitHub source link opens the source correctly.

versions.title: Autumn hero, three nav and banner variants
versions.changes: Cut the landing page down to the nav, a promo banner, the hero and the foundation section. Three variants: / has the banner above a dark nav, /v2 puts the banner under it, /v3 has a dark brown banner over a bundle-coloured nav with the headline and rating over the image. The banner retracts when scrolling down and slides back in when scrolling up, and the headline's second line types.

versions.title: Perfect Portions copy and Bio tag
versions.changes: New copy for the four tags under the meals title and the Perfect Portions Plan modal (icon removed). Added a Bio tag with the EU organic label first in the meal detail tags for apple cinnamon porridge, pitaya smoothie and vanilla hazelnut muesli.

versions.title: Bio tag image size
versions.changes: Bio tag image now displays at 16px tall (28px wide) instead of 32px, so it sits level with the other tags.

versions.title: New preferences section and goal follow-ups
versions.changes: Goal "Get more protein" is now "Nutrition for fitness". Weight and fitness goals get a follow-up question on what drives them. After the household question there is a food preferences section: a break screen, spicy, cuisine, and allergies (allergens only if Yes). Removed the "what do you like on your plate" question. Design QA pass: no blur on step transitions, instant face swap on the satisfaction scale, eager images, check icons in the routine section, and the loader crossfades into the results.

versions.title: Hero iteration, v0.2
versions.changes: Next iteration of the immunity landing page hero, pushed from the new shared prototypes workspace.

versions.title: Image paths fixed for the studio
versions.changes: No design changes. Re-pushed so the images with root-relative paths (logo and hero images) load in the studio, using the push script's new path fix.

versions.title: Personalised box results page
versions.changes: Rebuilt the results page around the V2 recommendation engine: the quiz answers now build a personal box of 16 or 20 meals (live Storyblok meals) instead of matching a bundle. Tapping a meal opens a sheet to swap it (ranked swap options, meals already in the box last) or change how many; add-ons are recommended, never pre-added, and allergens get their own panel. Variants A–D try different ways of sharing the answers across the hero headline, the three hero numbers and the tags; finished-quiz answers carry over between variants.

versions.title: Studio controls
versions.changes: The Start at, Results page and Bundle controls now show in the studio, so you can jump straight to the results and switch between variants A–D. They were in the wrong file, so v0.2 shipped without them.

versions.title: Variant switching and image preload
versions.changes: Switching the Results page control now goes straight to that variant's results with the answers from your last finished quiz, instead of back to the homepage. Quiz images are fetched while the homepage loads, so no step waits on its image. Dropped the old Bundle control.

versions.title: Cuisine badges, no ratings
versions.changes: Meal cards show a cuisine icon next to the chilli, only for cuisines you said you liked (from Kristina's comment, applied to every variant). Removed the star ratings from meal and swap cards, since too few recipes have enough reviews.

versions.title: Swap sheet rework and swap animation
versions.changes: The swap sheet now has three parts: Recommended for you (with your taste answers as keywords under it), More meals, and Already in your box as 'Add a portion', plus a clear message when nothing new fits your allergens. Meals you've swapped out move to the back of the choices. A swap now closes the sheets and plays on the whole card: the old meal draws back and dissolves, the new one springs in.

versions.title: Quiz sections, routine story, new recipe modal
versions.changes: Quiz intro now lays out the two parts (About you, Your food) and the box they lead to, Hers-style; the break screen repeats that list one step on, and the progress bar is split into one track per part. Results variant A gets a goal-specific section above the meals: the rules we used to pick their meals, each with a short fact on why it matters, and a sheet with the full reasoning and numbers from their own box (copy is a draft, needs nutritionist sign-off). The meal sheet now uses the bundle test's recipe modal: square photo, short description, macro bar, curated tags, key ingredients with photos, reshaped nutrition table and reviews; this also fixes the nutrition table, which rendered empty before.

versions.title: Discount unlock moment, results variation C, /results page
versions.changes: Adding a meal or portion that reaches a bigger discount tier now plays a full-screen celebration (animated gradient, confetti, big badge, one dismiss button). Results now rise up and fade in, hero then body, instead of sliding sideways. B's hero button is gone. New variation C condenses the recommendation section into several executions to review (highlights, numbers, swipe cards, ledger, ticked list, numbered, lead-with-one, tabs). New /results page: the phone-frame review view with every quiz answer and variant switch, for showing others.

versions.title: New intro, emoji questions, swap and toast polish
versions.changes: Intro and break screens redesigned to the Figma (numbered timeline list, 'Lets go'); question options now emojis (spicy as a three-chilli rating); challenge USP art replaced; loader copy sharpened and 0.5s longer. Results: consultation page is now A and the default, nutrition stats sit under 'Meals in your routine', meal stats lead with the goal's nutrient, new toast, swap modal cards carry the price in the button, discount screen always sits above modals, one-person box starts at 15. Review panel gained flow points and a hide toggle; studio controls now cover results page, headline, goal, challenge and allergies.

versions.title: Studio controls for every answer
versions.changes: Studio controls now mirror the review panel: results page (A consultation, B you), the goal, and every quiz answer including allergens, each option selectable; C, D, Heroes and the headline control are left out. B's dynamic headline no longer carries emojis. Also in this version: new intro and break screens, emoji question options, new toast, swap modal cards with the price in the button, nutrition stats under 'Meals in your routine'.

versions.title: Studio answer controls as chips
versions.changes: The studio controls for challenges, typical week, cuisine, what they look for and allergens are now single-choice chips (first pick) instead of an On/Off switch per option, since the studio has no multiple choice.

versions.title: Multi-select controls and live updates
versions.changes: Studio controls for challenges, typical week, cuisine, what they look for and allergens are multi-select chips. The prototype now tells the studio it is ready and takes control changes as messages, so changing a control updates it in place instead of reloading.
